fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Enable DIR coupler inhibition.

fields.label: amount
fields.tooltip: Global multiplier on the DIR coupler inhibition matrix. 1.0 leaves the per-channel gammas as-is.

fields.label: inhibition samelayer
fields.tooltip: Multiplier on the same-layer (diagonal) inhibition. Controls overall contrast / gamma reduction within each RGB layer.

fields.label: inhibition interlayer
fields.tooltip: Multiplier on the cross-layer (off-diagonal) inhibition. Controls saturation enhancement from interlayer DIR effects.

fields.label: gamma samelayer rgb
fields.tooltip: Per-channel same-layer DIR gamma (R, G, B). Effective gamma reduction of each layer's density curve.

fields.label: gamma interlayer r to gb
fields.tooltip: DIR inhibition from the R layer onto the G and B layers respectively (g_R->G, g_R->B).

fields.label: gamma interlayer g to rb
fields.tooltip: DIR inhibition from the G layer onto the R and B layers respectively (g_G->R, g_G->B).

fields.label: gamma interlayer b to rg
fields.tooltip: DIR inhibition from the B layer onto the R and G layers respectively (g_B->R, g_B->G).

fields.label: langmuir donor k rgb
fields.tooltip: NEGATIVE film: per-channel Langmuir saturation of DIR inhibitor release, normalized to each layer's d_max (R, G, B). Lower = earlier, stronger roll-off at high density (gentler shoulder, tames high-amount breakage); large values approach the linear model.

fields.label: langmuir receiver k rgb
fields.tooltip: POSITIVE/reversal film: per-channel receiver-side Langmuir saturation (R, G, B), normalized to the arrived-inhibitor ceiling (the receiver analogue of langmuir_donor_k_rgb's d_max normalization). The donor (silver release) stays linear; this rolls off the receiving layer's response under a pushed amount. Lower = harder, more crash-proof knee (alters the operating-point look); large values approach linear.

fields.label: diffusion size um
fields.tooltip: Sigma in um for the diffusion of the couplers, (5-20 um), controls sharpness and affects saturation.

fields.label: diffusion tail um
fields.tooltip: Exponential tail scale in um for long-range coupler spread. Larger values extend the rare long-distance inhibition halo beyond the Gaussian core.

fields.label: diffusion tail weight
fields.tooltip: Fraction of coupler diffusion energy assigned to the long tail. 0 = pure Gaussian spread, higher values add a longer-range inhibition shoulder.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Enable halation and in-emulsion scatter.

fields.label: scatter amount
fields.tooltip: High-level scatter strength. 1.0 = full physical scatter, 0.0 = no scatter. Scales the fraction of light that undergoes in-emulsion scattering.

fields.label: scatter spatial scale
fields.tooltip: High-level scatter size multiplier (1.0 = physical defaults). Scales both core and tail sigmas.

fields.label: halation amount
fields.tooltip: High-level halation strength multiplier (1.0 = physical defaults). Scales the per-channel halation amplitudes.

fields.label: halation spatial scale
fields.tooltip: High-level halation size multiplier (1.0 = physical defaults). Scales the first-bounce sigma.

fields.label: boost ev
fields.tooltip: Maximum highlight boost in stops.

fields.label: protect ev
fields.tooltip: Protected range above midgray for the boost onset in stops.

fields.label: boost range
fields.tooltip: Controls how quickly the highlight boost ramps in, from 0 to 1.

fields.label: scatter core um
fields.tooltip: Sigma of the scatter core Gaussian per channel [R,G,B], in micrometers. Controls fine-scale sharpness loss in the emulsion.

fields.label: scatter tail um
fields.tooltip: Decay constant of the scatter exponential tail per channel [R,G,B], in micrometers (internally approximated by a sum of Gaussians). Controls extended low-level spread within the emulsion.

fields.label: scatter tail weight
fields.tooltip: Weight of the scatter tail Gaussian per channel [R,G,B] (0-1). Tail weight + core weight = 1. Higher values put more scattered light into the long tail.

fields.label: halation strength
fields.tooltip: Total back-reflection halation amplitude per channel [R,G,B] (0-1). Typical red channel: weak AH 0.02-0.08, no AH 0.08-0.25. The blue channel is usually near zero.

fields.label: halation first sigma um
fields.tooltip: Sigma of the first halation bounce per channel [R,G,B], in micrometers. Set by the base thickness (40-80 um for typical cine/still bases).

fields.label: halation n bounces
fields.tooltip: Number of multi-bounce Gaussians summed in the halation pass. Subsequent bounces use sqrt(k)-spaced widths. Typical: 2-3.

fields.label: halation bounce decay
fields.tooltip: Per-bounce amplitude decay ratio (rho). Physical range 0.3-0.7. Controls how fast the halation energy falls off between bounces.

fields.label: halation renormalize
fields.tooltip: If enabled, divide by (1 + sum of bounce amplitudes) so mid-grey is preserved. If disabled, halation is purely additive and subtly lifts shadows as well as highlights.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Add grain to the negative

fields.label: rms granularity
fields.tooltip: Per-channel (RGB) RMS granularity from the datasheet (sigma_D x 1000, 48 um aperture, net density 1.0). Higher = coarser grain. Typical consumer films ~4 (fine) to ~40 (coarse).

fields.label: density min
fields.tooltip: Minimum density of the grain, typical values (0.03-0.06).

fields.label: uniformity
fields.tooltip: Grain uniformity per channel; lower bends the noise curve toward the Selwyn bell, typical values (0.94-0.98).

fields.label: particle scale sublayers
fields.tooltip: Relative particle-area scale per emulsion sublayer (coarsest sublayer = 1, finer sublayers smaller).

fields.label: blur
fields.tooltip: Sigma of gaussian blur in pixels for the grain, to be increased at high magnifications, (should be 0.8-0.9 at high resolution, reduce down to 0.6 for lower res).

fields.label: mult usm sigma
fields.tooltip: Radius (px) of the density unsharp mask. Broad (default 0.7) puts the acutance in the mid-band, away from Nyquist, so the pixel stays gone while perceived sharpness comes back.

fields.label: mult usm amount
fields.tooltip: Strength of the mass-conserving density unsharp mask applied after the grain blur: it makes the pixel/sampling grid disappear while keeping the grain and image content (positive, mass-conserving, not a denoiser). 0 disables. Default 1.5.

fields.label: blur dye clouds um
fields.tooltip: Scale the sigma of gaussian blur in um for the dye clouds, to be used at high magnifications, (default 1).

fields.label: micro structure
fields.tooltip: Clumps at the molecular level, [sigma blur of micro-structure / ultimate light-resolution (0.10 um default), size of molecular clumps in nm (30 nm default)]. Only for insane magnifications.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Add glare to the print

fields.label: percent
fields.tooltip: Percentage of the glare light (typically 0.1-0.25)

fields.label: roughness
fields.tooltip: Roughness of the glare light (0-1)

fields.label: blur
fields.tooltip: Sigma of gaussian blur in pixels for the glare

fields.label: development time
fields.tooltip: Development time for a BW development-time family: selects the density curve and base+fog to render. '—' uses the representative middle development; ignored for single-curve and color stocks.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Enable print density-curve morphing.

fields.label: gamma factor
fields.tooltip: Global coupled gamma multiplier for the print density curves.

fields.label: gamma factor fast
fields.tooltip: Gamma factor applied to the fast sub-layer.

fields.label: gamma factor slow
fields.tooltip: Gamma factor applied to the mid and slow sub-layers.

fields.label: gamma factor red
fields.tooltip: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the red channel.

fields.label: gamma factor green
fields.tooltip: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the green channel.

fields.label: gamma factor blue
fields.tooltip: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the blue channel.

fields.label: developer exhaustion
fields.tooltip: Blend all three print sub-layers toward the matched Gumbel shoulder while preserving midgray via a common horizontal offset.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Enable print base-density tuning.

fields.label: scale
fields.tooltip: Overall multiplier on the print base density.

fields.label: cyan
fields.tooltip: Cyan-channel multiplicative scale of the print base min around 610 nm (1.0 = neutral).

fields.label: magenta
fields.tooltip: Magenta-channel multiplicative scale of the print base min around 530 nm (1.0 = neutral).

fields.label: yellow
fields.tooltip: Yellow-channel multiplicative scale of the print base min around 445 nm (1.0 = neutral).

fields.label: development time
fields.tooltip: Development time for a BW development-time family: selects the density curve and base+fog to render. '—' uses the representative middle development; ignored for single-curve and color stocks.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Enable film density-curve morphing.

fields.label: gamma factor
fields.tooltip: Global coupled gamma multiplier for the film density curves.

fields.label: gamma factor fast
fields.tooltip: Gamma factor applied to the fast sub-layer.

fields.label: gamma factor slow
fields.tooltip: Gamma factor applied to the mid and slow sub-layers.

fields.label: gamma factor red
fields.tooltip: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the red channel.

fields.label: gamma factor green
fields.tooltip: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the green channel.

fields.label: gamma factor blue
fields.tooltip: Per-channel gamma factor applied to the blue channel.

fields.label: developer exhaustion
fields.tooltip: Blend all three film sub-layers toward the matched Gumbel shoulder while preserving midgray via a common horizontal offset.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Enable film base-density (film base + fog / orange mask) tuning.

fields.label: scale
fields.tooltip: Overall multiplier on the film base density.

fields.label: tilt
fields.tooltip: Spectral tilt of the film base, pivoting at 555 nm (1.0 = +0.1 density at 650 nm; negative tilts the other way).

fields.label: cyan
fields.tooltip: Cyan-channel film base density shift around 650 nm (1.0 = neutral; adds (value - 1) density).

fields.label: magenta
fields.tooltip: Magenta-channel film base density shift around 555 nm (1.0 = neutral; adds (value - 1) density).

fields.label: yellow
fields.tooltip: Yellow-channel film base density shift around 460 nm (1.0 = neutral; adds (value - 1) density).

actions.label: Detect base
actions.tooltip: Sample the clear/unexposed film from the brightest pixels of the current image (see Base percentile) and fit the film Base + exposure so the unexposed film maps to density 0. Run this first.

actions.label: Blind calibration
actions.tooltip: Fit the Calibration matrix from the CURRENT image and write it above. Works best on a vibrant, colour-filled frame (it aligns the scanned colours to the film's dye gamut); a flat/neutral frame gives a weak fit. Review/edit the values afterwards.

actions.label: Neutralize print filters
actions.tooltip: Solve the print enlarger M and Y filter shifts so the current film + base midgray prints neutral. Image-independent; run it after Detect base (a tuned base changes the print balance). Writes Print M/Y filter shift in Enlarger.

fields.label: scan illuminant
fields.tooltip: Light source of the scanning / capture rig used to digitize the negative. Set it to match your rig (a physical input); the film Base is the creative lever. Only used by the 'convert-film' workflow routes.

fields.label: exposure compensation ev
fields.tooltip: Aligns the scan's overall brightness to the model (gain = 2^ev). Brighter input -> less recovered film density.

fields.label: base percentile
fields.tooltip: Brightest-pixels percentile used by 'Detect base' to sample the clear / unexposed film (99 = brightest 1%). Detect base fits the film Base so that clear film maps to density 0 (unexposed -> neutral).

fields.label: calibration
fields.tooltip: 3x3 device-correction matrix (9 numbers, row-major) applied to the input before inversion, to undo the scanner/camera colour rendering vs the standard observer over the film dyes (the cross-channel cast that the scan illuminant and base cannot reach). Editable and copy/paste-able; an invalid string falls back to identity (no correction). Use 'Blind calibration' to fit it from the current image.

fields.label: exposure
fields.tooltip: Preflash exposure value in ev for the print

fields.label: y filter shift
fields.tooltip: Shift the Y filter of the enlarger from the neutral position for the preflash, typical values (-20-20), in Kodak CC units

fields.label: m filter shift
fields.tooltip: Shift the M filter of the enlarger from the neutral position for the preflash, typical values (-20-20), in Kodak CC units

fields.label: exposure compensation ev
fields.tooltip: Add a bias to the auto-exposure of the camera.

fields.label: auto exposure
fields.tooltip: Use the auto-exposure feature of the virtual camera.

fields.label: film format mm
fields.tooltip: Long edge of the film format in millimeters, e.g. 8, 16, 35, 60, 120.

fields.label: auto exposure method
fields.tooltip: Metering method used by the virtual camera's auto-exposure.

fields.label: color filter
fields.tooltip: Camera taking filter held in front of the lens. Its measured spectral transmittance multiplies the incoming light, so it both darkens and color-casts the exposure (e.g. Hoya Y2/YA3 yellow, R1 red, X0/X1 UV/haze). 'none' = no filter.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Toggle the diffusion filter (Pro-Mist family).

fields.label: filter family
fields.tooltip: PSF family. pro_mist / glimmerglass / cinebloom are transparent (energy-preserving); black_pro_mist absorbs a fraction of the deflected light, lifting shadows by reducing local contrast.

fields.label: strength
fields.tooltip: Commercial filter stop: 0, 1/8=0.125, 1/4=0.25, 1/2=0.5, 1, 2. Maps internally to the (p_s, p_a) deflected/absorbed photon fractions.

fields.label: spatial scale
fields.tooltip: Multiplier on the image-plane PSF widths (all per-group lambdas). Adjust for image-format / print-size differences.

fields.label: halo warmth
fields.tooltip: Additive offset on the family's halo warmth axis. Positive = warm outer halo / cool inner halo. Energy-preserving per channel. 0 = use family default.

fields.label: core intensity
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the core weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: core size
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the core lambda. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: halo intensity
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the halo weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: halo size
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the halo lambda. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: bloom intensity
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the bloom weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: bloom size
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the bloom lambda. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Toggle the diffusion filter (Pro-Mist family).

fields.label: filter family
fields.tooltip: PSF family. pro_mist / glimmerglass / cinebloom are transparent (energy-preserving); black_pro_mist absorbs a fraction of the deflected light, lifting shadows by reducing local contrast.

fields.label: strength
fields.tooltip: Commercial filter stop: 0, 1/8=0.125, 1/4=0.25, 1/2=0.5, 1, 2. Maps internally to the (p_s, p_a) deflected/absorbed photon fractions.

fields.label: spatial scale
fields.tooltip: Multiplier on the image-plane PSF widths (all per-group lambdas). Adjust for image-format / print-size differences.

fields.label: halo warmth
fields.tooltip: Additive offset on the family's halo warmth axis. Positive = warm outer halo / cool inner halo. Energy-preserving per channel. 0 = use family default.

fields.label: core intensity
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the core weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: core size
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the core lambda. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: halo intensity
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the halo weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: halo size
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the halo lambda. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: bloom intensity
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the bloom weight; the three group weights are renormalized to sum to 1. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: bloom size
fields.tooltip: Advanced. Multiplier on the bloom lambda. 1.0 = use family default.

fields.label: lens blur
fields.tooltip: Sigma of gaussian filter in pixel for the scanner lens blur.

fields.label: white correction
fields.tooltip: Enable white point correction applied to the scanner output.

fields.label: white level
fields.tooltip: Target white level applied when white correction is enabled.

fields.label: black correction
fields.tooltip: Enable black point correction applied to the scanner output.

fields.label: black level
fields.tooltip: Target black level applied when black correction is enabled.

fields.label: unsharp mask
fields.tooltip: Apply unsharp mask to the scan, [sigma in pixel, amount].

fields.label: active
fields.tooltip: Compress input chromaticities toward the visible spectral locus before spectral upsampling. Off passes input through unchanged.

fields.label: algorithm
fields.tooltip: xy: radial compression in CIE 1931 chromaticity toward the spectral locus / inscribed hull (ACES RGC family, preserves dominant wavelength). The only input algorithm.

fields.label: knee
fields.tooltip: Reinhard knee (threshold, limit, power). Default (0.815, 1.0, 1.2) — ACES RGC pair: the 0.815 threshold leaves in-gamut colours untouched, the 1.2 power gives a slow tail so deep-imaginary colours keep their gradation, and limit 1.0 asymptotes on the boundary.

fields.label: hull detail
fields.tooltip: Detail of the inscribed-hull compression boundary = number of FFT modes kept. HIGHER keeps more locus detail (more cusp chroma) but re-admits polygon kinks; LOWER is smoother, rounding the spectral tips inward toward a circle. Note: this is modes-kept, not a blur width — larger means LESS smoothing.

fields.label: algorithm
fields.tooltip: off: disable output gamut compression. aces_rgc (default): per-channel ACES RGC v1.3, matches Resolve/Nuke/OCIO and is the cheapest per pixel. cam16ucs: CAM16-UCS chroma reduction with the smoothest constant-hue behavior (heaviest). oklch: perceptual chroma reduction in OkLab, preserves hue + lightness. oklrab/jzazbz: alternative perceptual spaces.

fields.label: knee
fields.tooltip: Reinhard knee (threshold, limit, power) on normalized chroma C/C_max. Default (0.0, 1.0, 6.0) rolls off smoothly from the center with the asymptote on the output cube edge.

display.label: use display transform
display.tooltip: Use Pillow.ImageCms to retrive the display transform (only in Windows) and apply it to the napari viewer output, if disabled the output color space is used

display.label: gray 18% canvas
display.tooltip: Use neutral 18% gray as backgroung to judge the exposure and neutral colors

display.label: white padding
display.tooltip: Expand the white border layer around the normalized preview frame, expressed as a fraction of the image long edge.

display.label: preview max size
display.tooltip: max size of the long edge of the preview image in pixels

display.label: output interpolation
display.tooltip: Napari interpolation mode used to display the output layer in the viewer.

input_image.label: input color space
input_image.tooltip: Color space of the input image, will be internally converted to sRGB and negative values clipped

input_image.label: apply cctf decoding
input_image.tooltip: Apply the inverse cctf transfer function of the color space

input_image.label: upscale factor
input_image.tooltip: Scale image size up to increase resolution

input_image.label: crop
input_image.tooltip: Crop image to a fraction of the original size to preview details at full scale

input_image.label: crop center
input_image.tooltip: Center of the crop region in relative coordinates in x, y (0-1)

input_image.label: crop size
input_image.tooltip: Normalized size of the crop region in x, y (0,1), as fraction of the long side.

input_image.label: spectral upsampling
input_image.tooltip: Method to upsample the spectral resolution of the image, hanatos2025 works on the full visible locus, mallett2019 works only on sRGB (will clip input).

input_image.label: hanatos2025 adaptation window
input_image.tooltip: Apply the hanatos2025 bandpass adaptation window when reconstructing spectra.

input_image.label: hanatos2025 adaptation surface
input_image.tooltip: Apply the hanatos2025 surface adaptation polynomial when reconstructing spectra.

input_image.label: spectral gaussian blur
input_image.tooltip: Sigma in nm for Gaussian blur applied to reconstructed spectra.

load_raw.label: white balance
load_raw.tooltip: Leave at daylight (D65): it is the colorimetric reference the rest of the pipeline assumes, and should not be changed. Do not use it to neutralize a colour cast — fix white balance downstream with the enlarger filters instead. (custom exposes temperature/tint for special cases.)

load_raw.label: temperature
load_raw.tooltip: Temperature in Kelvin for the custom whitebalance, not used for the other white balance settings

load_raw.label: tint
load_raw.tooltip: Tint value for the custom white balance, not used for the other white balance settings

simulation.label: print exposure
simulation.name: print_exposure
simulation.tooltip: Changes the exposure time set in the virtual enlarger

simulation.label: print auto compensation
simulation.name: print_exposure_compensation
simulation.tooltip: Auto adjust the print exposure for the camera exposure compensation ev

simulation.label: print y filter shift
simulation.name: print_y_filter_shift
simulation.tooltip: Y filter shift of the color enlarger from a neutral position, in Kodak CC units

simulation.label: print m filter shift
simulation.name: print_m_filter_shift
simulation.tooltip: M filter shift of the color enlarger from a neutral position, in Kodak CC units

simulation.label: output color space
simulation.tooltip: Output color space of the simulation

simulation.label: saving color space
simulation.tooltip: Color space of the saved image file

simulation.label: saving cctf encoding
simulation.tooltip: Add or not the CCTF to the saved image file

simulation.label: auto preview
simulation.tooltip: trigger the preview after every change of gui parameters, use mouse scrollwheel on parameters field, read preview tooltip for details

simulation.label: workflow
simulation.tooltip: Which path the image takes through the pipeline: input (passthrough: just colour-manage the input to the output space for viewing), input > film > scan (scan the negative directly), input > film > print > scan (full chain), input > convert-film > print > scan (print a scene-referred input and scan it), input > convert-film > scan-minus-base (convert input and scan with base removed), input > convert-film > scan (convert input, then scan the film with its base).
